newsitem.title: CHINA: China end-February foreign reserves over $111 bln.
newsitem.headline: China end-February foreign reserves over $111 bln.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves grew to exceed a record $111 billion at the end of February, State Statistical Bureau spokesman Qiu Xiaohua said on Friday.
China's foreign exchange reserves reached $105 billion at the end of 1996, up $31.5 billion from the end of 1995.
The central bank, the People's Bank of China, has said it expects the country's foreign exchange reserves to grow by at least $20 billion this year.
